input.question: Do pets feel emotion toward owners?
input.ground_truth: Both pets and pet owners experience an [increase in oxytocin](_URL_2_) when they're together. Oxytocin is the same chemical involved in [maternal bonding](_URL_2_). Based on that, I'd say there's a pretty good chance that dogs and other pets can form attachments to their owners.
